name: Duler angels
description: Artifact angels living in the Duler Sanctum who guard Lat-Nam.

timeline.summary: The party teleports to Lat-Nam, is attacked by Duler angels and Copper Conch merfolk, and Greensleeves befriends them.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves communicates with the angels and the merfolk, who had been tasked by the Sages to be guardians of Lat-Nam, and befriends them.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves and her party come to Lat-Nam in 4077 AR to uncover the secrets of the Stone Brain, battling and befriending its guardians.
timeline.quote: After a battle, Greensleeves befriended the guardians and led an excavation
